recent_excerpts: CVE-2025-39964, a race condition in the Linux kernel's AF_ALG socket code, is now in CISA's KEV catalog. Federal agencies must remediate by September 21, 2026.
CISA added CVE-2026-42016, a JFrog Artifactory token-scope authorization flaw enabling privilege escalation, to its KEV catalog with a Sept 25 patch deadline.
CISA's KEV catalog now lists CVE-2026-20079, a CVSS 10.0 authentication bypass in Cisco software, alongside exploited Citrix and Fortinet flaws. Federal patch deadline: Sept. 12.
